records.text: An Invisible Stalker found in Ulduar.

Hodir is an Ulduar giant. He warns intruders they will suffer and calls on northern winds. His taunts mock defeated challengers; when freed, he says he has finally been released from another's grasp, suggesting he had been held under control.

Stormcaller Brundir is an Ulduar boss who dismisses challengers as mere mortals. He attacks with blinding light and calls down deadly storms from the air. At death, he declares that the storm's power lives on, making that force central to his identity.

Thorim’s kingdom in Ulduar lies in ruins. His brother was corrupted and killed his wife Sif. During the encounter he mistakes the champions for intruders and later recognizes them, then realizes he has been trapped in a nightmare. He questions whether Sif was present, knowing she is dead, and promises to aid the champions after their victory.

Steelbreaker is a member of Ulduar’s Assembly of Iron. He taunts intruders, derides flesh as frail, and treats Ulduar’s secrets as a weapon; his lines portray him as hostile, contemptuous of mortals, and confident in the Assembly.

Freya is a guardian of Ulduar’s Conservatory who seeks to protect it and calls on the Elders. She speaks of being under another’s hold, then seeing clearly again and thanking the heroes; she conveys regret and a return of agency.

Elder Ironbranch is a hostile figure connected to Freya at Ulduar. He rejects mortals’ presence and threatens to send them away; as he falls, he warns Freya that intruders are coming, placing him in a defensive role around her.
Elder Stonebark is an ancient, powerful being who serves the Matron. When the Conservatory is threatened, he fights its attackers; even in defeat, he warns the Matron to flee.
Elder Brightleaf serves the Matron in the Conservatory. He raises the alarm when it is breached and treats fallen attackers as nourishment for the soil, reflecting his place among its defenders.
A Dark Rune Champion is one of the more formidable members of the Dark Rune presence in this area, distinguished by a champion’s standing among its common folk and specialist ranks.
Dark Rune Commoners represent the common folk, alongside champions, evokers and warbringers.
A Dark Rune Evoker is a specialist among the Dark Rune presence in the area, distinct from its common folk, champions and warbringers.
A Dark Rune Warbringer is a martial specialist among the Dark Rune presence in the area, distinct from its common folk, champions and evokers.

Runemaster Molgeim is a hostile Ulduar boss who wields death and storm runes. He regards mortals’ losses as insignificant, calls their deaths the price of arrogance, and promises that the legacy of storms will endure. His declaration that the Assembly of Iron is adjourned places him in that gathering.
Kologarn is an Ulduar boss who bars passage and challenges intruders. Its combat lines dismiss injuries to its arms as minor and taunt its opponents with blunt claims of failure and oblivion.
Dark Matter in Ulduar.

Flame Leviathan is a Keeper-created machine serving as Ulduar's first line of defense in the Formation Grounds. Its threat assessments, target acquisition and course changes present it as a protocol-driven war machine that pursues perceived enemies. The Kirin Tor believe it may be transported and unleashed elsewhere, though this is their reported intelligence.

Ignis the Furnace Master is a fire giant working in Ulduar's Colossal Forge under Loken's orders, making weapons intended to reclaim the world. He summons soldiers of the iron crucible to serve the Maker's will and treats intruders as fuel or impurities for his forge. His threats cast him as a committed servant of the Maker's campaign.
Iron Constructs are mechanical beings in Ulduar.

Sara appears distressed in the Yogg-Saron encounter, pleading for help before urging attackers to focus their anger on the beast and its minions. She celebrates their violence and exhorts them to keep attacking, then reveals a true form. Her pleas therefore conceal a hostile role.
A passive golem-hand helper stationed in Ulduar's Colossal Forge area.
A passive golem-hand helper stationed in Ulduar's Colossal Forge area.

Razorscale is a broodmother who normally keeps to her aerie near Ulduar's Colossal Forge. The Council of Six describes her as a threat after she began raining fire on lands outside the titan complex, and has ordered her death. In battle she breathes fire and can enter a berserk rage.
Mechanolift 304-A is a mechanical unit found across several areas of Ulduar.

Brann Bronzebeard explores Ulduar with his companions. He links Loken's death to Azeroth's Prime Designate, wonders what Algalon will learn from his diagnostics, and is baffled by cryptic clues about watchers and sigils. He delights in discoveries and urges his companions toward the Celestial Planetarium.
A Steelforged Defender is one of Ulduar's forged guardians, armed with Lightning Bolt.
A massive Ulduar colossus that attacks with Ground Slam.
An Ironwork Cannon is a stationary weapon that holds its ground instead of pursuing targets.

General Vezax threatens a new age of suffering and calls defiance a mortal flaw. He declares that Yogg-Saron's black blood courses through him, boasts of being unstoppable, and treats his opponents' defeat as inevitable. Even as he dies, he wonders what horrors await.
The Voice of Yogg-Saron is a taunting presence that tells its target their will is no longer their own, then commands a minion to destroy them at its master's order.

XT-002 Deconstructor is a deadly construct of Mimiron that thinks itself the keeper's son. It greets new toys with an innocent promise not to break them, then sets old toys against new ones. When its heart is exposed it complains of tiredness, but after its tantrum it seems bewildered by what it has broken.
XT-Toy Pile is a named presence in Ulduar.

Mimiron is an inventive, playful machine-maker who recruits his visitors to test his latest creation, teasing them that they owe him after the XT-002 mess. He is flustered by unexpected company and his messy workshop, and mock-scolds them over a forbidden-button mishap. He admits that a fiend in the prison corrupted his mind and overrode his primary directive; afterward, he says his systems are functional again.
Corrupted Servitor is a combat creature that casts Petrify Joints and Violent Earth.
Misguided Nymph is a creature that casts Frost Spear.
Thunder Orb is an encounter entity.
Leviathan Mk II is a named, massive mechanical combatant in Ulduar. It begins to cast Plasma Blast.
Auriaya is a named Ulduar adversary who treats intruders as a waste of her time and warns that a secret will die with them. Her battle calls and threats present her as a determined defender.
Nature's Blade is a combatant at Ulduar. Its attacks include Living Tsunami.
Guardian of Life is a combatant at Ulduar. Its attacks include Poison Breath.
The Ulduar Gauntlet Generator is a scripted mechanism used in the Storm Beacon spawn sequence.

Brann Bronzebeard directs the expedition's assault on Ulduar, ordering the magical shield lowered and allies admitted while warning of Iron Dwarf attacks from bunkers. He sends participants into siege machines and says he will coordinate by radio; his exchange with Archmage Pentarus shows him issuing orders to the Kirin Tor mages.
An Earthen Stoneshaper humanoid in Ulduar.
Goran Steelbreaker is a humanoid.

Archmage Pentarus is a Kirin Tor mage supporting Brann's Ulduar expedition: he says he helped fund it after Brann asked and marvels at seeing Ulduar. On Brann's command, he tells the Kirin Tor mages to lower the shield and defend the platform, invoking Dalaran as they prepare to fight.

An Explorer's League engineer still trying to understand unfamiliar technology, they admit the device is beyond them but insist they have not given up. Their caution tempers their determination: they ask the player not to expect a quick breakthrough.
A hired demolitionist associated with K3.
Weslex Quickwrench is a senior siege engineer who says he escaped a steamy jungle and became the lead engineer of the expedition. His expertise centers on the expedition's siege engines.
Armsweep Stalker Kologarn is found in Ulduar.

A Kirin Tor battle-mage helping investigate a suspected transporter for an assault. They speak cautiously about its potential, saying it could prove useful if their suspicions are right, and check on progress.

Blastwrench is a K3 demolisher engineer who says the expedition found enough parts to get its demolishers working again. Their greeting pairs practical pride in the repair with an immediate offer of help.
These Kirin Tor mages are spellcasters identified with the Kirin Tor and present in Ulduar's complex.

The Lore Keeper of Norgannon is a constructed information repository for Ulduar, built to report on the complex's frontal defenses and the entity imprisoned there. Its measured reports identify Yogg-Saron, describe iron constructs, Storm Beacons and orbital emplacements, and acknowledge that security has been compromised and the prison's status is unknown. Its records also present an option to activate secondary defenses.

Archmage Rhydian is a Kirin Tor mage working with Brann's expedition at Ulduar. He credits their allies for fighting well and relays what scouts have seen: a giant construct before the gate. With the Kirin Tor unable to spare more resources, he proposes slipping past the defenses after bringing down that construct so the group can enter.
Storm Tempered Keepers are mechanical wardens associated with Ulduar. Their name marks them as storm-tempered guardians.

High Explorer Dellorah is an Explorers' League member investigating Ulduar. She compares its Lore Keeper with one she heard of in Uldaman, asks about the defenses, and tells Rhydian to alert Brann and Archmage Pentarus. Learning Yogg-Saron is there, she expects a difficult fight and remarks that the orbital emplacements need not be faced.
A storm-tempered keeper is a powerful creature in Ulduar. It is associated with the storm-tempered keeper role there.
A Dark Rune Thunderer is an elite Dark Rune combatant in Ulduar.
A Dark Rune Ravager is an elite Dark Rune combatant in Ulduar.
A Faceless Horror is a powerful hostile creature encountered in Ulduar. Its combat behavior includes casting a spell.
A Twilight Adherent is one of the combatants found in Ulduar.
A Twilight Frost Mage is one of the combatants found in Ulduar.
A Twilight Pyromancer is a combatant that casts Arcane Burst.
A Twilight Guardian is a combatant that casts Concussion Blow.
A Twilight Slayer is a combatant that casts Bladestorm.
Twilight Shadowblade is a combatant that casts Backstab and Fan of Knives.

The Archivum System serves as an analytical archive in Ulduar, linking the elders to changes in Freya’s powers. Its replies are terse and precise, from a numerical estimate to a denial when access is insufficient.

Prospector Doren helps Brann explore Ulduar and briefs adventurers on the sigils and the Celestial Planetarium. He lays out hard choices plainly: sparing Freya’s elders preserves the sigil’s integrity but leaves her stronger. His encouraging replies acknowledge the danger while welcoming help, and he treats the effort as a step toward saving Azeroth.

Prospector Loren helps Brann explore Ulduar and briefs adventurers on the sigils and the Celestial Planetarium. When the Planetarium entrance proves locked, he plans to tell Brann so he can investigate through the Archivum. His replies pair practical concern about the odds with encouragement when help arrives.
Sanctum Sentry is a creature whose name places it among the sanctum's guards.

Bronzebeard Radio broadcasts tactical warnings and guidance during the assault on Ulduar: it alerts listeners to danger, explains the generators and repair stations, and comments on Thorim's tower. The transmissions speak as a coordinated voice.
Molten Colossus is a molten giant that casts Earthquake and Pyroblast.
Forge Construct is a construct in Ulduar's forge environment that casts Flame Emission.
Magma Rager is a magma creature that casts Fire Blast.
Auriaya Feral Defender Stalker.
Champion of Hodir is a named combatant in Ulduar's Halls of Winter. It uses Stomp and Freezing Breath in combat, marking it as a formidable encounter foe rather than a conversational figure.
Winter Revenant is a Ulduar Halls of Winter combatant. It casts Blizzard.
Winter Rumbler is a Ulduar Halls of Winter combatant. It casts Cone of Cold.
A Mechagnome Battletank: an armored mechanical combatant equipped with a flame cannon and a jumping attack.
An Arachnopod Destroyer, a mechanical combatant associated with Ulduar.
A hardened iron golem, a combat construct found in Ulduar. It uses a rune punch in battle.
A mechanical construct designated “Trash,” found in Ulduar.
Boomer XP-500 is a mechanical combat construct found in Ulduar.
A Clockwork Sapper, a mechanical combatant found in Ulduar. It casts Energy Sap.
Rune Etched Sentries guard the halls of Ulduar, marked by runes and armed with Runed Flame Jets.
Chamber Overseers patrol Ulduar's halls and attack with a Devastating Leap, fitting their role as formidable chamber guards.
Iron Menders are mechanical guardians in Ulduar. They cast Electro Shock.
These Iron Dwarves are charged with lightning in Ulduar and use that charged power in combat.
Runeforged Sentries guard Ulduar, their runic forging reflected in their use of Runed Flame Jets. They appear across several halls.
Parts Recovery Technicians are mechanical figures in Ulduar's salvage area. Their combat repertoire includes a Mechano Kick.
XR-949 is a salvagebot found among the machinery in Ulduar's salvage area. It deploys salvage saws, giving its recovery work a dangerous edge.
XD-175 is a compactobot in Ulduar's salvage area. Its Trash Compactor attack makes clear that compaction is more than its name.
XB-488 is a mechanical disposal unit programmed to cut scrap metal. It can also self-destruct.

place_records.text: You are in Ulduar, a titan complex in The Storm Peaks, now held by Keeper-made machines and the forces of Loken. Ignis the Furnace Master makes weapons in the Colossal Forge meant to reclaim the world, Flame Leviathan guards the Formation Grounds as the first line of defense, and Kologarn bars the way. Iron constructs fill its halls. Algalon the Observer is said to beam messages to his Titan masters from the Celestial Planetarium, whose entrance has yet to be found.

You are in the Iron Concourse of Ulduar, where Bronzebeard Radio broadcasts warnings and guidance to the expedition and explains the generators and repair stations. Steelforged defenders, runeforged sentries, ironwork cannons and an Ulduar Colossus guard the concourse.

You are in the Formation Grounds before Ulduar, where Flame Leviathan, a Keeper-made machine, stands as its first line of defense. Steelforged defenders, runeforged sentries, mechanolifts and an Ulduar Colossus guard the approach.

You are in Razorscale's Aerie, where Razorscale, a broodmother, normally keeps to her aerie near the Colossal Forge. She began raining fire on the lands outside the titan complex, and the Council of Six calls her a threat. A mechanolift is here too.
You are in the Colossal Forge of Ulduar, where Ignis the Furnace Master makes weapons under Loken's orders to reclaim the world. Iron and forge constructs and magma ragers work the fires around him.

You are in the Scrapyard of Ulduar, the domain of the XT-002 Deconstructor, a deadly construct that thinks itself the keeper's son. Parts recovery technicians, salvagebots, compactobots and disposalbots pick through the scrap around it.

You are in the Conservatory of Life, a part of Ulduar where Freya guards the Conservatory and calls on the Elders. The essence of Freya's sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark, and harm to them compromises it. Mangrove ents, guardian lashers, forest swarmers and misguided nymphs are here too.

You are in Expedition Base Camp, where Brann Bronzebeard directs his expedition into Ulduar and warns of Iron Dwarf attacks from bunkers. Archmage Pentarus and Archmage Rhydian of the Kirin Tor are with him, and Rhydian reports a giant construct before the gate. Weslex Quickwrench, a senior siege engineer, works the siege engines, and the camp can sell supplies and mend gear.
